audience: online sellers who publish one product catalogue to Shopify, eBay, Etsy and Amazon from Nembol

useCases.title: Find products that are not listed on a channel
useCases.text: List the channel accounts, then search products and listings. Filter listings by status error to see each failure cause.

useCases.title: Read orders waiting for shipment
useCases.text: List the newest orders, then open one to read its lines, totals and fulfillment status.

useCases.title: Set stock and prices for many SKUs
useCases.text: Set the stock or price of up to 100 SKUs in one call. Follow the returned operation to see one result per SKU and channel.

useCases.title: Publish a product to one sales channel
useCases.text: Publish one product to one channel account. Publishing runs in the background, so follow it with the listing status.

useCases.title: Mark an order shipped with tracking
useCases.text: Read the order first, then mark it shipped with tracking. This cannot be undone. With tracking, the source marketplace is notified once per order.
